description: This file contains unit tests for the DynamoDB storage provider in an Orleans-based application, including tests for read/write operations, format conversions, and configuration changes.

classes.name: DynamoDBStorageProviderTests
classes.description: Unit test class for DynamoDB storage provider, testing read/write operations, format conversions, and configuration changes.

methods.name: PersistenceProvider_DynamoDB_WriteRead
methods.description: Tests writing and reading a grain state with optional JSON serialization.

methods.name: PersistenceProvider_DynamoDB_WriteClearRead
methods.description: Tests writing, clearing, and reading a grain state.

methods.name: PersistenceProvider_DynamoDB_ChangeReadFormat
methods.description: Tests changing the read format (JSON or binary) and verifying data consistency.

methods.name: PersistenceProvider_DynamoDB_ChangeWriteFormat
methods.description: Tests changing the write format and verifying data persistence.

methods.name: DynamoDBStorage_ConvertToFromStorageFormat
methods.description: Verifies conversion between in-memory state and storage format.

methods.name: InitDynamoDBGrainStorage
methods.description: Initializes a DynamoDB grain storage instance with specified options.

methods.name: Test_PersistenceProvider_Read
methods.description: Tests reading grain state from storage.

methods.name: Test_PersistenceProvider_WriteRead
methods.description: Tests writing and then reading grain state, verifying data integrity.

methods.name: Test_PersistenceProvider_WriteClearRead
methods.description: Tests writing, clearing, and then reading grain state to verify clearing.

methods.name: EnsureEnvironmentSupportsState
methods.description: Checks if the environment supports DynamoDB operations, skips test if not.
